comments.author: SmearODeer
comments.snippet:
This looks like the same crash as #2706 and #3307: `ConnectionWindow.Prot_Event_Closed` called `Invoke` on a panel that was already disposed, from the background thread in `ProtocolBase.CloseBG`.

That code was changed in 763fffff (2026-09-16): it now returns when the panel is disposed or has no handle, and uses `BeginInvoke` instead of `Invoke`. The change is included in **1.78.2 NB 3725** (2026-10-02) and later.
